name: Blue Dolphin Marine Tours
summary: Blue Dolphin Marine Tours is a family-run business sailing an 11.6m catamaran out of Urangan in Hervey Bay. It runs full-day whale watching from July to October, half-day dolphin trips and sunset sails for the rest of the year, and private charters. Numbers are kept to around 24 and the skipper gives the commentary himself.
standouts: Maximum of 24 passengers on an 11.6m sailing catamaran
Skipper Peter Lynch has over 40 years experience with marine mammals

contact.address: Berth B5 Great Sandy Straits Marina, Buccaneer Drive, Urangan, Hervey Bay 4655, Queensland, Australia

trips.title: Exclusive Whale Watching Encounter
trips.summary: A full day on the water in Hervey Bay during humpback whale season, on a sailing catamaran with no more than 24 guests. The skipper takes the boat to where the whales are resting and playing, and a hydrophone lets you hear them sing. Morning tea, a buffet lunch, a drink and pick-up from your accommodation are included.
highlights: Full day on the water, giving more time with the whales
Hydrophone on board to listen to the whales
In-water platform for an opportunistic whale immersion at no extra cost, weather and whales permitting
Courtesy pick-up and drop-off from your accommodation

trips.title: Dolphin Eco Adventure
trips.summary: A morning sail across the Great Sandy Strait to find wild bottlenose and Australian humpback dolphins along the south-west coast of K'gari. Turtles, dugongs and seabirds are often seen too. In summer, weather permitting, there is time to swim off a sand bank, ride the aqua mat or try the boom net.

Swim, AquaMat or boom net at Pelican Banks or Moon Point, K'gari, weather permitting
Morning tea and a fruit platter on the way back

trips.summary: A 90-minute evening sail on the Great Sandy Strait with views across Hervey Bay to K'gari as the sun goes down. Canapes, finger food and drinks are included. It runs from November to June.

trips.title: Private Sailing Charters
trips.summary: Exclusive use of the sailing catamaran for birthdays, weddings, staff parties, conferences and other events. The boat is surveyed for up to 30 passengers and works best for groups of 10 or more. Meals can be arranged for most dietary needs.
highlights: Up to 30 passengers, ideal group size 10 or more
Fully licensed, with meals on request
In-water platform and hydrophone on board
Available all year round

trips.title: K'gari (formerly Fraser Island) Exclusive Tours
trips.summary: A two-day package that pairs a one-day 4WD tour of K'gari with a whale watching or dolphin cruise. Choose a 17-seat bus, a 6-seat Landcruiser or a 4-seat Discovery tour. Stops include Central Station rainforest, Lake McKenzie, 75 Mile Beach, Eli Creek, the Coloured Sands and the Maheno shipwreck.
highlights: One-day K'gari tour combined with a whale watching or dolphin cruise
Three options: 17 seat bus, 6 seat Landcruiser or 4 seat Discovery
Central Station rainforest, Lake McKenzie, 75 Mile Beach, Eli Creek, the Coloured Sands, the Maheno shipwreck
Departs Hervey Bay every day except 25 and 26 December
